headers.//: Content Security Policy. The pages are served from here, not from Express, so this is where it has to live. script-src is 'self' with no unsafe-inline and no unsafe-eval: the build emits one external module and no inline script, so nothing legitimate needs them — and that is what stops an injected <script> from running at all. style-src keeps unsafe-inline because the component library sets style attributes directly on elements; style injection is a far smaller problem than script injection. connect-src names the API and its WebSocket explicitly, so even injected code has nowhere to send anything. frame-src allows the Google viewer used for Office previews and blob: for the generated booklet PDF. frame-ancestors 'none' is the clickjacking defence for the admin pages.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://140.245.224.137.nip.io wss://140.245.224.137.nip.io; frame-src 'self' blob: https://docs.google.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
